sentences.zh: 那么，辩论中哪些时刻最让你印象深刻？它们让你有什么想法和感受？

sentences.en: So maybe like an overall impression, I guess, of the debate that actually left me very frustrated with former President Trump was just his overall decorum, his rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 所以也许是一个总体的印象，我想，辩论中实际上让我对前总统特朗普感到非常沮丧的是他整体的礼仪和修辞。

sentences.en: My 16-year-old daughter was watching with me.
sentences.zh: 我16岁的女儿和我一起看。

sentences.en: And a big thing that we came back to was the opening of the debate and the fact that he made a beeline for the podium rather than trying to meet in the middle and handshake.
sentences.zh: 我们回想起来的一件大事是辩论的开场，他径直走向讲台，而不是试图在中间会合握手。

sentences.en: And she had to initiate that.
sentences.zh: 而且是她不得不主动发起握手。

sentences.en: And then throughout the debate, I can't recall a time when he actually made eye contact with her or looked at her.
sentences.zh: 然后在整个辩论过程中，我不记得有哪次他真的和她有眼神交流或看着她。

sentences.en: And then the way that he continued to refer to they, they, and that may have been part of his strategy is to continue to try to tie her to Biden.
sentences.zh: 还有他不断提到“他们，他们”的方式，这可能是他策略的一部分，试图继续把她和拜登捆绑在一起。

sentences.en: But in doing that without looking at her, without going in for that handshake, without actually addressing her, to me, it was very demeaning.
sentences.zh: 但这样做的时候不看着她，不主动去握手，不真正地回应她，对我来说，这非常贬低人。

sentences.en: So that really bothered me.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的困扰了我。

sentences.en: And then the fact that, to be honest, for the majority of the debate,
sentences.zh: 还有就是，老实说，在辩论的大部分时间里，

sentences.en: he looked like my daughters did when they were toddlers and they were not getting their own way or they had gotten yelled at and were sitting and pouting in the corner.
sentences.zh: 她看起来就像我女儿小时候那样，当她们没能如愿，或者被训斥了，就会坐在角落里生闷气。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of people have been remarking on Harris's facial expressions and gestures in response to some of the things that Trump was saying.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多人都在评论哈里斯对特朗普所说的一些话所表现出的面部表情和手势。

sentences.en: I'm curious how her expressions landed with you,
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，她的这些表情给你留下了什么印象？

sentences.en: especially in this context of you wanting a president who can work across the aisle and sort of lower the temperature on the rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 特别是在你希望有一位能够跨党派合作，并能缓和言辞激烈程度的总统这一背景下。

sentences.en: For me, I guess some of it just kind of made me laugh.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我想其中一些表情反而让我觉得好笑。

sentences.en: And honestly, it was just like, okay, she's making this face and I'm making the same face here at home.
sentences.zh: 老实说，当时的感觉就是，好吧，她做了这个表情，而我在家里也做了同样的表情。

sentences.en: Like, what did she just say?
sentences.zh: 就像是，她刚才说了什么？

sentences.en: Like, how was this, you know, did that actually come out?
sentences.zh: 就像是，这怎么可能，你知道，这话真的是从她嘴里说出来的吗？

sentences.en: And I didn't think it was over the top.
sentences.zh: 而且我不觉得这有什么过火的。

sentences.en: I didn't think she was disrespectful in any way.
sentences.zh: 我不认为她在任何方面表现得不尊重。

sentences.en: So it didn't really sway me one way or the other.
sentences.zh: 所以这并没有真正动摇我的立场。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I wanted to ask you about a couple of things you mentioned to me when we had our conversation before.
sentences.zh: 我想问你几个我们之前交谈时你提到过的问题。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You mentioned that the economy was a big issue for you.
sentences.zh: 你提到经济对你来说是一个大问题。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, is that still true?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这现在还适用吗？

sentences.en: And can you talk a little bit about how the debate affected your thinking on how the candidates would approach economic issues?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈这场辩论是如何影响你对候选人将如何处理经济问题的看法的吗？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: No, definitely the economy is still a major issue for me.
sentences.zh: 不，经济绝对仍然是我关注的一个主要问题。

sentences.en: To be honest, I was really disappointed in both candidates.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我对两位候选人都感到非常失望。

sentences.en: I was really hoping to hear something more.
sentences.zh: 我真的希望能听到更多实质性的内容。

sentences.en: For me, Donald Trump, all he was talking about was tariffs.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，唐纳德·特朗普一直在谈论的只有关税。

sentences.en: And that's not going to fix the economy in and of itself.
sentences.zh: 而这本身并不能解决经济问题。

sentences.en: And so there was nothing else there from him.
sentences.zh: 所以他没有提出其他任何东西。

sentences.en: And Kamala, while she did have her three points, you know, she was talking about small business.
sentences.zh: 至于卡玛拉，虽然她确实提出了她的三点主张，你知道，她在谈论小企业。

sentences.en: She was talking about $25,000 for first-time homeowners, $6,000 for families in the first year of life.
sentences.zh: 她在谈论为首次购房者提供2.5万美元，为新生儿家庭提供6000美元。

sentences.en: And I'm sure there's people out there for that.
sentences.zh: 我相信肯定有人支持这些政策。

sentences.en: That was wonderful.
sentences.zh: 那很好。

sentences.en: And they were happy to hear that.
sentences.zh: 他们听到这些也很高兴。

sentences.en: But I'm a college-educated woman, working class, in my 40s.
sentences.zh: 但我是一个受过大学教育的工薪阶层女性，四十多岁。

sentences.en: I own a home, and I have teenage children.
sentences.zh: 我有房，还有十几岁的孩子。

sentences.en: So for me, this is all great.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这些都很棒。

sentences.en: You know, she's focusing on how to help people get started.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她专注于如何帮助人们起步。

sentences.en: How do you help all of the millions of Americans who are already small business owners?
sentences.zh: 那么，你如何帮助数百万已经拥有小企业的美国人呢？

sentences.en: I work for a small business owner.
sentences.zh: 我为一位小企业主工作。

sentences.en: You know, for homeowners, in the last five to seven years, our homeowners' insurance has basically doubled.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对于房主来说，在过去五到七年里，我们的房屋保险基本上翻了一番。

sentences.en: So what are you going to do for homeowners?
sentences.zh: 那么你打算为房主做些什么呢？

sentences.en: How are you going to help us to continue to live in our homes, to maintain our homes?
sentences.zh: 你打算如何帮助我们继续住在自己的房子里，维护我们的房子？

sentences.en: Those are the things that I really would have liked to have seen from her last night, and I didn't.
sentences.zh: 这些是我昨晚真正希望从她那里看到的，但我没看到。

sentences.en: So there was one more thing.
sentences.zh: 还有一件事。

sentences.en: You mentioned reproductive rights in our conversation last time.
sentences.zh: 你上次谈话中提到了生育权。

sentences.en: Do you kind of lean toward one or the other on that issue?
sentences.zh: 在这个问题上，你更倾向于哪一方？

sentences.en: So this is one of those, I think, too, where I kind of struggle because people, they want to pigeonhole you into one view or the other.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是一个让我感到纠结的问题，因为人们总是想把你归入某一种观点。

sentences.en: You know, if you're conservative, you view it this way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你是保守派，你就这样看。

sentences.en: And if you're liberal, you view it this way.
sentences.zh: 如果你是自由派，你就那样看。

sentences.en: And I, when it comes to, you know, reproductive rights and specifically abortion, I do have very strong feelings about the manner in which that should be utilized.
sentences.zh: 而我，当谈到生育权，特别是堕胎时，对于应该如何行使这项权利，我确实有非常强烈的感受。

sentences.en: I do consider myself pro-life, so more of a conservative.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为自己是反堕胎者，所以更偏向保守派。

sentences.en: You know, I don't view that as a means of birth control.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不认为这是一种避孕手段。

sentences.en: But I do also understand and can appreciate through different experiences, life experiences of my own, I can understand where this is not a black and white issue.
sentences.zh: 但我同时也理解，通过我自己的不同人生经历，我能明白这不是一个非黑即白的问题。

sentences.en: And there has to be room for that.
sentences.zh: 必须有回旋的余地。

sentences.en: There has to be exceptions.
sentences.zh: 必须有例外情况。

sentences.en: There has to be places where this can happen.
sentences.zh: 必须有允许这种情况发生的地方。

sentences.en: And so I'm still struggling personally with, like, yes, I don't want to see it used in this way,
sentences.zh: 所以我个人仍然很纠结，比如，是的，我不希望看到它被这样使用，

sentences.en: but I don't want to see people being stuck in a position where they have no choices.
sentences.zh: 但我也不希望看到人们陷入一种别无选择的境地。

sentences.en: And so she kind of backed away from answering how she felt about late-term abortion.
sentences.zh: 她回避了回答她对晚期堕胎的看法。

sentences.en: And I was kind of wishing she would have talked about that.
sentences.zh: 我当时确实希望她能谈谈这个问题。

sentences.en: But by the same token, I was thoroughly disgusted by his comments.
sentences.zh: 但同样地，我对他的言论感到非常厌恶。

sentences.en: And, you know, he kept calling it abortion after birth.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他一直称之为“出生后堕胎”。

sentences.en: But if a child is born, it's not abortion.
sentences.zh: 但如果孩子已经出生了，那就不叫堕胎了。

sentences.en: Like, it's just by definition.
sentences.zh: 这在定义上就是不对的。

sentences.en: And so essentially you're talking about, you know, execution of children.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上你谈论的是杀害儿童。

sentences.en: And to me, that was just so off the wall.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这简直是荒谬至极。

sentences.en: And so, I mean, for him to continue spewing that is just sickening.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，他继续散布这种言论简直令人作呕。

sentences.en: I know you said earlier that you were still struggling, but did the debate help you make up your mind on who to vote for?
sentences.zh: 我知道你刚才说你还在纠结，但这场辩论是否帮助你决定了要投给谁？

sentences.en: Um, I don't know if I'm comfortable, like, even, like, with myself to myself yet.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道我是否已经准备好面对自己了。

sentences.en: I'm not sure that I'm comfortable saying yes or no to that one way or the other.
sentences.zh: 我不确定自己是否能肯定或否定地回答这个问题。

sentences.en: I'm not sure what I'm hoping to hear yet.
sentences.zh: 我不确定我还在期待听到什么。

sentences.en: You know, I don't know if there's something that I'm wanting to hear.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不知道是否还有什么是我想要听到的。

sentences.en: Whether it's right or wrong or makes any sense, when you grow up a certain way, whether you grow up liberal or you grow up conservative, I think it is hard for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 无论对错或是否有意义，当你以某种方式成长时，无论你是作为自由派还是保守派长大，我认为这对很多人来说都是困难的。

sentences.en: If that's what you've always been and that's what you've known and you've been very comfortable in that, I think there is just some level of uncomfortableness.
sentences.zh: 如果你一直以来都是这样，这就是你所了解的，并且你对此感到非常自在，我认为这会带来某种程度的不适感。

sentences.en: And I don't know, you know, subconsciously, if you feel like you're betraying what you are and where you've been, even though that's not true, you know,
sentences.zh: 我不知道，你知道，潜意识里，你是否觉得自己在背叛你的身份和过去，尽管事实并非如此，你知道，

sentences.en: people grow and people evolve.
sentences.zh: 人们会成长，人们会进化。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't say that, like, I would be changing necessarily my values or where I necessarily see things falling on policy,
sentences.zh: 我不会说，我一定会改变我的价值观或我对政策的看法，

sentences.en: but it's coming down to more of a matter of let's restore some civility and decorum into the White House.
sentences.zh: 但这更多归结为我们要恢复白宫的文明和礼仪的问题。

sentences.en: The sanctity of the president of the United States, that office, what that means, what that stands for.
sentences.zh: 美国总统的尊严，那个职位，它的意义，它所代表的东西。

sentences.en: And let's try to start bringing people back together.
sentences.zh: 让我们试着开始让人们重新团结起来。

sentences.en: You know, one thing she said last night was let the divisiveness be on the policy issues, not on all of this other unimportant stuff that we're trying to make into issues.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她昨晚说的一件事是，让分歧留在政策问题上，而不是我们试图制造出来的那些不重要的琐事上。

sentences.en: And that's essentially dividing us.
sentences.zh: 而这本质上是在分裂我们。

sentences.en: Well, there's not a whole lot of time till the election.
sentences.zh: 好吧，距离选举没剩多少时间了。

sentences.en: And I know you said that you're not quite sure what you're hoping to hear.
sentences.zh: 我知道你说你不太确定自己希望听到什么。

sentences.en: But I'm wondering, if it gets to be November 5th, what do you think you'll do?
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，如果到了11月5日，你觉得你会怎么做？

sentences.en: Do you think you'll go to the voting booth and make the call there?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你会走进投票站并做出决定吗？

sentences.en: Or is there a chance you might stay home?
sentences.zh: 还是说你可能会待在家里？

sentences.en: No, I definitely will not stay home.
sentences.zh: 不，我绝对不会待在家里。

sentences.en: I definitely will vote.
sentences.zh: 我一定会去投票。

sentences.en: Or writing in, you know?
sentences.zh: 或者写下候选人名字，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Not.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, I know we had talked about writing in a candidate.
sentences.zh: 是的，我知道我们谈过写下候选人名字的事。

sentences.en: I think after last night, I would feel more comfortable making a decision versus writing someone in off the cuff.
sentences.zh: 我想昨晚之后，比起临时写下某人的名字，我更愿意做出一个决定。

sentences.en: I would say that it definitely pushed me in one direction.
sentences.zh: 我会说这确实推动了我向某个方向靠拢。

sentences.en: After watching him and listening to him and the attempts to find ways to continue to divide us,
sentences.zh: 在观察他、听他说话以及他试图寻找各种方式继续分裂我们之后，

sentences.en: and the way that he treated her last night, and the way that he treated the American public, it definitely pushed me to vote for Kamala.
sentences.zh: 以及他昨晚对待她的方式，还有他对待美国公众的方式，这确实推动我投票给卡玛拉。

sentences.en: This was so interesting, Emily.
sentences.zh: 这太有趣了，艾米丽。

sentences.en: I'm really, really grateful to you for talking to me.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常非常感谢你和我交谈。

sentences.en: Well, I thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，谢谢你的时间。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Take care, Emily.
sentences.zh: 保重，艾米丽。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: Have a good night.
sentences.zh: 晚安。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Over the next 49 days, we'll keep in touch with Bob, Sharon, and Emily to learn who they ultimately chose to vote for and why.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的49天里，我们将与鲍勃、莎伦和艾米丽保持联系，了解他们最终选择了谁以及原因。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的事情。

sentences.en: The American media totally ignored this stuff until Donald Trump and I started talking about cat memes.
sentences.zh: 美国媒体完全无视这些东西，直到唐纳德·特朗普和我开始谈论猫咪表情包。

sentences.en: In an interview on Sunday with CNN, Senator J.D.
sentences.zh: 在周日接受CNN采访时，俄亥俄州参议员J.D.

sentences.en: Vance of Ohio, the Republican vice presidential nominee,
sentences.zh: 万斯，共和党副总统候选人，

sentences.en: said that he stood by the debunked claims spread by he and Donald Trump that Haitian migrants in his state were eating people's pets.
sentences.zh: 表示他坚持他和唐纳德·特朗普散布的已被揭穿的说法，即他所在州的海地移民正在吃人们的宠物。

sentences.en: If I have to create stories so that the American media actually pays attention to the suffering of the American people, then that's what I'm going to do, Dana, because you guys...
sentences.zh: 如果我必须编造故事才能让美国媒体真正关注美国人民的苦难，那么我就会这么做，达娜，因为你们这些家伙……

sentences.en: Moments later, on the same network, the Democratic governor of Pennsylvania, Josh Shapiro, scolded Vance for standing by those false claiMs.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，在同一个电视网，宾夕法尼亚州民主党州长乔什·夏皮罗斥责万斯坚持这些虚假指控。

sentences.en: I mean, Dana, that was bonkers.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，达娜，那太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Listen, the governor of Ohio, the mayor of that town in Ohio, has said this is all made up.
sentences.zh: 听着，俄亥俄州的州长，那个俄亥俄州城镇的市长，都已经说过这一切都是编造的。

sentences.en: These are all lies.
sentences.zh: 这些全是谎言。

sentences.en: There is no truth to it.
sentences.zh: 这根本不是事实。

sentences.en: And the United States senator from Ohio just came on your show and blamed his own constituents for his own lies.
sentences.zh: 而这位来自俄亥俄州的美国参议员刚刚出现在你的节目中，并因为他自己的谎言而指责他自己的选民。

sentences.en: This guy's so pathetic, but...
sentences.zh: 这家伙太可悲了，但是……

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
